items.title: Rui Hachimura on advice he’s given to Keaton Wagler: “You just got to play hard. Every game coming out just being aggressive. Not offensively, just everything—defense, rebounds, everything. You just got to try to play harder. ... He’s going to be fine for sure.”
items.author: Justin Russo

items.title: Keaton Wagler on conversations with Tyronn Lue about off-ball comfort (and ghost screens): “We’ve had good conversations, kind of just like with [Darius Garland], just being more of a second action guy for me, just being ready to either catch and shoot or play off a second side.”

items.title: Keaton Wagler on how he’s felt next to Darius Garland: “I think it’s kind of just made a lot smoother transition, not having to just get thrown right into the fire and have people hounding me. He’s definitely good to bring pressure off me and then I can do the same for him.”
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: Keaton Wagler on how he’s felt next to Darius Garland: “I think it’s kind of just made a lot smoother transition, not having to just get thrown right into the fire and have people hounding me. He’s definitely good to bring pressure off me and then I can do the same for him.”

items.title: Tyronn Lue on Keaton Wagler being so comfortable off-ball as a spot-up threat: “He can also handle the pressure as well. But just when you’ve got a young player, a lot of times they’re scared to attack, knowing when to attack the pressure. But he’s been doing a really good job.”
